T1.title: Network fabric
T1.line: It travels along glass threads that carry light, and a switch sends it to the right computer.

T2.title: Retrieval
T2.line: Your question finds the closest note cards, in blue.

T3.title: To the GPU server
T3.line: That message goes to a machine built for heavy maths, cooled by water.

acts.title: The follow
acts.line: The message climbs out of the server and rides the cable tray.

acts.title: The drop
acts.line: It drops into a machine built for heavy maths.

acts.title: The descent
acts.line: Inside, water carries the heat away from every chip.

T4.title: Prefill
T4.line: Then it keeps notes about your message in a tall memory tower.

T5.title: Decode
T5.line: Each new word is saved as a note in the tower.

T6.title: KV cache
T6.line: The notes are stored in same-size blocks, like pages.

T7.title: Eight GPUs
T7.line: Eight chips share the work and add up their answers.

T8.title: Memory tiers
T8.line: A fast shelf, a big shelf, a huge slow one.

T9.title: The way out
T9.line: The answer travels back out of the building.

arc.note: Both lines are written by hand. Empty renders nothing.
